metadata.name: UpdateStockRequest
metadata.description: This API is used to update the request parameters of an existing stock request.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: OrderID
request_fields.description: Order ID of the Bulk card order. Valid Values:0-9 Example: 12345 Condition:Either of one identifier is mandatory from:OrderID, BulkCardUUID

request_fields.name: BulkCardUUID
request_fields.description: Unique number Bulk card order Valid Values:0-9 Example: 12345 Condition:Either of one identifier is mandatory from:OrderID, BulkCardUUID Allowable Values: 64

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressLine1
request_fields.description: Shipping address line 1. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:2354 Main road Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShippingAddressLine2
request_fields.description: Shipping address line 2 Valid Values: A-Z, 0-9 Example:xyz Avenue Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: ShippingCity
request_fields.description: Shipping address city name. Example:Los Angeles Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: ShippingPostalCode
request_fields.description: Zip code of the shipping address. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:46206 Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 9

request_fields.name: ShippingCountry
request_fields.description: Shipping address Country name. Example:US Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: ShippingState
request_fields.description: State of the shipping address. Format:XXXXX Example: AL Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 30

request_fields.name: Title
request_fields.description: Title of Person to whom stock is shipped. Example:Mr Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 5

request_fields.name: FirstName
request_fields.description: First name of Person to whom stock is shipped. Example:User1 Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: MiddleName
request_fields.description: Middle Name of Person to whom stock is shipped. Example: LEE Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: LastName
request_fields.description: Last name of Person to whom stock is shipped. Example: Smith Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: NameOnCard
request_fields.description: Name to be printed on the card. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Example:John J Condition:If not given then First Name + Last Name will be printed Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: EmbossingLine4
request_fields.description: Embossing line4. Condition: Please refer Appendix Section 5.50 (Vendor wise field length) for field length supported by embossing vendor. Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: HoldEmbossing
request_fields.description: Hold Embossing indicator Valid Values:1= YES, 0 = NO Format:  X Example: 1

request_fields.name: DeliveryMechanism
request_fields.description: Shipment delivery mechanism.By Default Setting must be for standard Delivery Valid Values: Standard = 0, Priority = 1, Overnight = 2 Example:0

request_fields.name: NumberOFCard
request_fields.description: Embossing quantity for request made. Valid Values:0-9 Example:10

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ResponseID
children.description: This number indicates that API responded. Response ID is unique.
